rows.row: | w4-at-security-ops follow-up 18 | SECOPS-F17-01 answered, under D-160 (`docs/e2e/at/secops/2026-11-04-follow-up-18.md`). Diagnosis first: run b2de46c8's old killed-agent lease-expiry case used a stale cached deadline; its two held checks were retries of one admission read; its records show no accepted-deadline overrun, and the renewed lease's ID and issue time were not retained. The case now reads D after the control stop, from the node's accepted local lease and its serving heartbeat, requiring a 60 s cap, a lifetime in (0, 60 s] and a matching future monotonic D; every traffic predicate is unchanged. D-160 is committed harness code: an admission journal, a free check right before each of six timed sections, execution receipts and no admission inside a section, and an offline validator; 509 checks (507 free, 2 held), none inside a section. Live run 9d927350, after one allowed pre-subject rerun (the first dispatch's admission helper recursed through a wrapped PATH and its 11,215 owned processes were stopped; fixed with a regression test): the old case quiet from D + 0.39 s, the watchdog having withdrawn first; the live-agent case continuous to D - 0.99 s and quiet by D + 2.01 s on one agent; grant expiry, device revoke with bounded relay and manual grant withdrawal pass. AT29 goes from failed to blocked: guest clock rollback still needs an independently clocked guest. The lane recorded the run as confounded under D-133. Earlier failed runs stay failed. 6 commits, 217 owned files, mostly records. Session on codex gpt-6-astra. | done (#464) |

| w1-netlab follow-up 36 | D-161 in the pure D-120 classifier (docs/poc/G2-followup36-2026-11-04.md): a TCP read timeout counts as a guard loss only when the complete checked combined captures attribute every lost transmission of the stalled bytes to exactly one verified guard bracket within 100 ms, the bytes and the in-order echo then arrive on the same connection, and no reset or close occurs. Any other TCP failure, or missing TCP captures, still fails (iv), and guard-attributed timeouts count toward the five-loss allowance. Verdict strings, exit status and existing fields are unchanged. Gate 2: AT10 PASS under D-120, with 64 TCP reads, 0 timeouts, 8 guard-attributed transmissions recovered without a timeout, a 217.7 ms longest stall and 0 UDP losses. Replays: live2 to live5 and follow-up 35's gate 2 stay PASS, live1's original failure stays recorded, and F22-01 (7b0db5f2) and B1 stay FAIL for missing TCP captures. 76 offline tests; all 13 agent lab scenarios pass.
